subject: A new Deducer plugin for moderated multiple regressions

messages.author: 478086b2fcb52506
messages.subject: A new Deducer plugin for moderated multiple regressions
parts:
Dear All,
A new Deducer Plugin is available from CRAN. Using my pequod package,
DeducerMMR performs moderated multiple regressions (with centered and
uncentered predictors and with residual centering), simple slopes
analysis and a slopes plot.
Cheers,
Alberto
